description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceGuard and OptionalDeviceGuard classes in the c10 library of PyTorch, mainly verifying device reset functionality across different device types like CUDA and HIP.

classes.name: DeviceGuard
classes.description: A guard object that manages device context switching for a specific device.

classes.name: OptionalDeviceGuard
classes.description: An optional guard that manages device context switching if a device is set.

classes.name: FakeGuardImpl
classes.description: A fake implementation used for testing device guard behavior.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Resets the device of the guard to a new device.

methods.name: setDeviceIndex
methods.description: Sets the current device index in the fake implementation.

methods.name: getDeviceIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current device index in the fake implementation.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the current device the guard is managing.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the original device before any reset.
